title: WeatherWise Supply Chain Explorer
description: Ask about cold-chain shipments, delays, temperature excursions, surgeries at risk, backup inventory, supply sites, hospitals/clinics, suppliers and SOPs for MedTech surgical supplies.

question: Which STAT shipments to NYC will arrive after their scheduled surgery?
Which active shipments have a temperature excursion right now?
What are the top delay reasons this week?
Which hospitals have the most delayed inbound shipments?
Where is backup Aortic Valve inventory near New York?
What is the delay rate by carrier?

description: Destination metro in 'City, ST' form; NYC boroughs are all 'New York, NY'.
Why the shipment is delayed (weather, JFK backlog, reefer fault, ...). Empty when not delayed.
Destination metro 'City, ST'. For NYC use destination = 'New York, NY'.
Current (revised) ETA. Compare with original_eta_date to see slippage.
Latest payload sensor reading in F. Excursion when above temperature_max_f or below temperature_min_f.
Scheduled surgery that depends on this shipment.
Upper limit of the product's allowed range (SOP-specific: -4F frozen sealant, -40F frozen bone allograft, 46F refrigerated, 77F valve or stent, 86F balloon).

content:
Domain: cold-chain shipments of temperature-sensitive MedTech and surgical biologics (frozen fibrin sealant, frozen bone allograft, refrigerated thrombin hemostat, corneal grafts, bioprosthetic aortic valves, coated cardiac stents, drug-coated balloon catheters) from suppliers to hospitals and clinics.
For KPI questions (delay rate, excursions, procedures at risk, average delay) prefer the shipment_risk_metrics metric view and use MEASURE() on its measures.
Temperature excursion = last_recorded_temp_f > temperature_max_f OR last_recorded_temp_f < temperature_min_f, using that shipment's own limits. Ranges differ by product: frozen fibrin sealant -22 to -4F, frozen bone allograft -112 to -40F, refrigerated thrombin hemostat and corneal graft 36-46F (2-8C), bioprosthetic aortic valve 50-77F (never freeze), coated cardiac stent 59-77F, drug-coated balloon 59-86F. Freezing is an excursion for valves, thrombin and corneal grafts. Warming or thawing is an excursion for frozen products. Heat is the excursion for coated stents and balloons.
Active shipment = status <> 'Delivered'. Delayed = status = 'Delayed'.
Surgery / procedure at risk = an active shipment whose eta_date is after its procedure_date. 'At risk with no buffer' = DATEDIFF(procedure_date, eta_date) <= 1.
NYC, New York, Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx and Staten Island all mean shipments.destination = 'New York, NY' (or facilities.metro = 'New York, NY').
Weather is not stored in these tables. For weather or forecast questions, say the WeatherWise agent checks live forecasts; don't infer weather from the data.
For backup or alternate inventory, use inventory with on_hand_qty > 0, joined to sites for location; prefer lots with the latest lot_expiry and sites in the same state or metro as the destination.
Escalation tiers, contacts and SLAs differ by product and supplier. Read supplier_sops.product_doc for the shipment's product_id; never apply one 2-8C rule to every product.
Always show shipment_id, product_name and the destination facility name when listing shipments.

question: Which STAT shipments to NYC will arrive after their scheduled surgery?
sql:
SELECT s.shipment_id, s.product_name, s.destination_facility_name, s.status, s.delay_reason,
       s.original_eta_date, s.eta_date, s.procedure_date, s.last_recorded_temp_f
FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.shipments s
WHERE s.destination = 'New York, NY'
  AND s.priority = 'STAT'
  AND s.status <> 'Delivered'
  AND s.eta_date > s.procedure_date
ORDER BY s.procedure_date, s.eta_date

question: Which active shipments have a temperature excursion?
sql:
SELECT s.shipment_id, s.product_name, s.destination_facility_name, s.status, s.priority,
       s.last_recorded_temp_f, s.temperature_min_f, s.temperature_max_f, s.delay_reason
FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.shipments s
WHERE s.status <> 'Delivered'
  AND (s.last_recorded_temp_f > s.temperature_max_f OR s.last_recorded_temp_f < s.temperature_min_f)
ORDER BY s.last_recorded_temp_f DESC

question: Where is backup Aortic Valve inventory near New York?
sql:
SELECT i.site_id, i.site_name, st.site_type, i.city, i.state, i.on_hand_qty, i.lot_expiry
FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.inventory i
JOIN __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.sites st ON st.site_id = i.site_id
WHERE i.product_name = 'Bioprosthetic Aortic Valve (bovine tissue)'
  AND i.on_hand_qty > 0
  AND i.state IN ('NY', 'NJ', 'CT', 'PA')
ORDER BY i.on_hand_qty DESC, i.lot_expiry DESC

question: What is the delay rate by carrier?
sql:
SELECT `Carrier`, MEASURE(`Shipments`) AS shipments, MEASURE(`Delayed Shipments`) AS delayed,
       MEASURE(`Delay Rate`) AS delay_rate, MEASURE(`Avg Delay Hours`) AS avg_delay_hours
FROM __CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.shipment_risk_metrics
GROUP BY `Carrier`
ORDER BY delay_rate DESC
